A native constructor is invoked through its C pointer with an undefined `this`. Bound functions concatenate arguments and recurse. Otherwise the constructor's `prototype` becomes the instance prototype, `class_name` is set from the function name and the constructor body runs; an object returned by the body wins, otherwise the fresh instance is returned.

bind_target.brief: 把值绑定或赋值到一个绑定目标 / Bind or assign a value to a single binding target

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.id: 目标标识符节点或解构模式 / Identifier node or destructuring pattern
params.v: 被绑定或赋值的值 / Value being bound or assigned
params.declare: 声明式绑定为 1，纯赋值为 0 / 1 for a declarative binding, 0 for a plain assignment

bind_target.details: 标识符目标在声明模式下走 `js_env_declare`；赋值模式下写已存在的槽位，槽位不存在时严格模式报 `is not defined`、非严格模式写入全局环境。非标识符目标转交给 `bind_pattern` 或 `assign_pattern`。 | An identifier target uses `js_env_declare` when declaring; when assigning it writes the existing slot, and a missing slot raises `is not defined` in strict mode or defines it on the global environment otherwise. A non-identifier target is handed to `bind_pattern` or `assign_pattern`.

pattern_bind_decl.brief: 声明式解构的叶子操作适配器 / Leaf adapter for declarative destructuring

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.pat: 解构模式节点 / Destructuring pattern node
params.value: 被解构的值 / Value being destructured

pattern_bind_decl.note: 以 `declare = 1` 调用 `bind_pattern`，使解构走声明路径 / Calls `bind_pattern` with `declare = 1` so the walk takes the declaration path

pattern_bind_plain.brief: 赋值式解构的叶子操作适配器 / Leaf adapter for plain destructuring

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.pat: 解构模式节点 / Destructuring pattern node
params.value: 被解构的值 / Value being destructured

pattern_bind_plain.note: 以 `declare = 0` 调用 `bind_pattern`，使解构走赋值路径 / Calls `bind_pattern` with `declare = 0` so the walk takes the assignment path

pattern_each_array.brief: 按数组模式逐项解构可迭代值 / Destructure an iterable element by element against an array pattern

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.pat: 数组模式节点 / Array pattern node
params.value: 被解构的可迭代值 / Iterable value being destructured
params.apply: 对每个叶子目标执行绑定/赋值的回调 / Callback performing the bind or assign for each leaf target

pattern_each_object.brief: 按对象模式逐键解构对象值 / Destructure an object value key by key against an object pattern

params.pat: 对象模式节点 / Object pattern node
params.value: 被解构的对象值 / Object value being destructured
params.exclude: 收集已解构键的集合（可为 `NULL`）/ Set collecting already destructured keys, may be `NULL`
params.apply: 对每个叶子目标执行绑定/赋值的回调 / Callback performing the bind or assign for each leaf target

pattern_default_value.brief: 在值为 undefined 时求值解构默认值 / Evaluate a destructuring default when the value is undefined

pattern_default_value.note: 只有 `undefined` 触发默认值，`null` 不触发 / Only `undefined` triggers the default; `null` does not

bind_pattern.brief: 按声明或赋值语义解构一个模式 / Destructure a pattern in declaration or assignment mode

params.pat: 解构模式节点（可为 `NULL`）/ Destructuring pattern node, may be `NULL`
params.value: 被解构的值 / Value being destructured
params.declare: 声明式绑定为 1，赋值为 0 / 1 for a declarative binding, 0 for an assignment

assign_pattern.brief: 按赋值语义解构一个模式 / Destructure a pattern in assignment mode

params.value: 被解构的值 / Value being destructured

to_i32.brief: 按 ToInt32 规则把值转换为 32 位有符号整数 / Convert a value to a signed 32-bit integer per ToInt32

params.v: 待转换的值 / Value to convert

retval.0: 值为 NaN 或无穷时返回 0 / Returned for NaN or an infinity

js_instanceof.brief: 实现 instanceof 运算符 / Implement the `instanceof` operator

params.obj: 待检查的左操作数 / Left-hand operand being tested

bin_concat.brief: 把两个操作数转成字符串并拼接 / Stringify both operands and concatenate them

eval_logical.brief: 求值逻辑与、逻辑或与空值合并并短路 / Evaluate `&&`, `||` and `??` with short-circuiting

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: 二元表达式节点（子表达式在 kids 上）/ Binary expression node whose sub-expressions live in its kids

eval_logical.return: 决定结果的原始操作数，而非强制转换后的布尔值 / The deciding operand itself rather than a coerced boolean
eval_logical.note: `??` 只在左值为 `null` 或 `undefined` 时才求右值 / `??` evaluates the right side only for `null` or `undefined`

eval_relational.brief: 求值比较运算符 / Evaluate the relational operators

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: 比较表达式节点（决定具体运算符）/ Comparison node determining the operator

eval_relational.return: `<` `>` `<=` `>=` 的布尔结果 / The boolean result of `<`, `>`, `<=` or `>=`
eval_relational.note: 两侧均为字符串时按字典序 `strcmp` 比较，否则按数值比较；任一操作数为 NaN 时结果为 false / Two strings compare lexicographically via `strcmp`, otherwise numerically; a NaN operand always yields `false`

eval_arithmetic.brief: 求值算术、位与移位运算符 / Evaluate arithmetic, bitwise and shift operators

eval_bin.brief: 分派并求值二元表达式 / Dispatch and evaluate a binary expression

eval_bin.details: 逻辑与/或/空值合并先交给 `eval_logical`（不求值右操作数）。`instanceof` 先求左值再求右值交给 `js_instanceof`。相等类运算符用 `js_values_equal`（严格与否由运算符决定）。`in` 走 `eval_in_operator`，比较走 `eval_relational`，算术/位/移位走 `eval_arithmetic`，`+` 走 `bin_add`。未识别的运算符报错。 | Logical and/or/nullish go to `eval_logical` first, without evaluating the right operand. `instanceof` evaluates the left then the right and calls `js_instanceof`. Equality operators use `js_values_equal`, strictness determined by the operator. `in` uses `eval_in_operator`, comparisons use `eval_relational`, arithmetic/bitwise/shift use `eval_arithmetic` and `+` uses `bin_add`. params.n: 赋值表达式节点 / Assignment expression node

class_is_static_kind.brief: 判断成员种类是否安装到构造函数上 / Test whether a member kind installs on the constructor

class_install_member.brief: 按成员种类把一个类成员安装到原型或构造函数 / Install one class member onto the prototype or the constructor according to its kind

class_eval.brief: 求值类声明并构造原型与构造函数 / Evaluate a class declaration, building its prototype and constructor

params.n: 类声明节点 / Class declaration node

class_eval.return: 类构造函数值 / The class constructor value
class_eval.details: 有父类表达式时求值并判断派生关系（父类 `prototype` 为对象即为派生）。原型以类名命名，派生时链接到父类原型，否则链接 `Object.prototype`。显式构造函数节点存在时用它建函数，否则合成一个。随后设置构造函数的 `name`、`prototype` 与原型上的 `constructor`，派生类把构造函数的 `proto` 接到父类上以实现静态继承，最后安装全部成员；类名在词法环境中声明。 | A superclass expression, when present, is evaluated and the class counts as derived when the superclass `prototype` is an object. The prototype is named after the class and links either to the superclass prototype or to `Object.prototype`. An explicit constructor node is used when present, otherwise one is synthesised. The constructor's `name`, `prototype` and the prototype's `constructor` are then set, a derived class links its constructor's `proto` to the superclass for static inheritance, all members are installed, and the class name is declared in the lexical environment.

object_literal.brief: 求值对象字面量 / Evaluate an object literal

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: 对象字面量节点 / Object literal node

object_literal.return: 新建的对象值 / The newly created object value
object_literal.details: 展开属性（`JS_N_SPREAD`）把源对象的全部自有键拷贝过来；`__proto__` 属性设置 `proto`。属性键取自节点的 `str`，取值/方法/访问器由 `op` 区分：get/set 经 `js_obj_set_accessor`，方法经 `make_method`，普通属性求值（带默认值形式取其表达式分支）。 | A spread property (`JS_N_SPREAD`) copies every own key from the source object and a `__proto__` property sets `proto`. The key comes from the node's `str` and `op` selects a value, method or accessor: get/set via `js_obj_set_accessor`, methods via `make_method`, and a plain property is evaluated (a defaulted form takes its expression branch).

template_eval.brief: 求值模板字面量 / Evaluate a template literal

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: 模板字面量节点（`kids[0]` 为字面块表，其后为插值表达式）/ Template literal node whose `kids[0]` holds the literal chunks and whose following kids are the interpolations

template_eval.return: 拼接后的字符串值 / The concatenated string value
template_eval.note: 先按字节预估总长并一次分配，再逐块拷贝字面量与其后的插值（插值经 `js_to_string` 转换）/ The total byte length is computed up front and allocated once, then each literal chunk is copied followed by its interpolation stringified with `js_to_string`

eval_member.brief: 求值成员访问表达式 / Evaluate a member access expression

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: 成员访问节点 / Member access node

eval_member.return: 成员值；可选链在基值为 `null`/`undefined` 时返回 undefined / The member value, or undefined when an optional chain meets a `null` / `undefined` base
eval_member.note: 点式取 `str`，下标式对键表达式求值后转字符串；`num != 0` 标记可选链短路 / A dot form uses `str`, an index form evaluates and stringifies the key, and `num != 0` marks an optional chain that may short-circuit

eval_super_member.brief: 求值 `super.x` 成员访问 / Evaluate a `super.x` member access

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: super 成员访问节点 / `super` member access node

eval_super_member.return: 父原型上的成员值；无属性名时返回父原型对象；缺失时返回 undefined / The member value from the superclass prototype, the prototype object itself when no name is given, or undefined when absent
eval_super_member.note: 沿环境链寻找带 [[HomeObject]] 的作用域，取其 `home->proto` 与 `this`；找不到 home 时报 `'super' keyword unexpected here`；取值器以该 `this` 调用 / Walks the environment chain for the scope carrying a [[HomeObject]], using its `home->proto` and `this`; a missing home raises `'super' keyword unexpected here` and a getter is called with that `this`

args_init.brief: 初始化一个可变实参向量 / Initialise a growable argument vector

params.al: out:待初始化的实参向量 / Argument vector to initialise
params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.cap: 初始容量（小于 1 时按 1 处理）/ Initial capacity, clamped up to 1

args_init.note: count 归零，缓冲区由运行时分配器分配 / The count is reset to zero and the buffer comes from the runtime allocator

args_push.brief: 向实参向量追加一个值 / Append one value to an argument vector

params.al: inout:目标实参向量 / Target argument vector
params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.v: 要追加的值 / Value to append

args_push.note: 容量不足时按 `+8` 增长并拷贝已有元素 / When full the capacity grows by 8 and existing elements are copied

args_build.brief: 求值调用/构造节点的实参并展开 spread / Evaluate a call or construct node's arguments, flattening spreads

params.al: out:接收实参的向量 / Vector receiving the arguments
params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: 调用或构造节点 / Call or construct node
params.first: 起始子节点下标（跳过被调函数节点）/ Index of the first child to evaluate, skipping the callee node

args_build.note: spread 实参通过迭代协议（`js_iter_len` / `js_iter_at`）逐个展开后压入，使调用与构造共用同一条路径 / A spread argument is expanded through the iteration protocol (`js_iter_len` / `js_iter_at`), letting calls and constructs share one code path

eval_callee.brief: 解析被调函数及其 this 绑定 / Resolve a call's callee together with its `this` binding

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: 调用节点（`op == 1` 表示可选调用）/ Call node, where `op == 1` marks an optional call
params.callee_node: 被调函数节点 / Callee node
params.callee: out:解析出的被调函数值 / Resolved callee value
params.thisv: out:对应的 this 值 / Matching `this` value

eval_callee.return: 0 表示可选调用在 `null`/`undefined` 上短路，1 表示可以继续调用 / 0 when an optional call short-circuits on `null` / `undefined`, 1 when the call may proceed
eval_callee.note: 方法调用把 `this` 绑到基对象；`super.m()` 把 `this` 绑到类的自身实例（经 `js_env_this_env`）/ A method call binds `this` to the base object；`super.m()` binds `this` to the class's own instance via `js_env_this_env`

super_call.brief: 在派生构造函数中执行 `super(...)` / Perform a `super(...)` call inside a derived constructor

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.n: super 调用节点 / `super` call node

super_call.return: 父构造函数返回的对象；未返回对象时返回当前 `this` 实例 / The object returned by the parent constructor, or the current `this` instance when it returns none
super_call.details: 沿环境链查找带 [[HomeObject]] 的作用域以取得 `home` 与 `this`。取 `home->proto` 上的 `constructor` 作为父构造函数，若不可调用则报错。用 `args_build` 求值实参，再以 `derived = 1` 运行父构造函数体（因此父类字段在 `super()` 之后才安装到该实例上）。 | The environment chain is walked for the scope carrying a [[HomeObject]] to obtain `home` and `this`. The `constructor` on `home->proto` is taken as the parent constructor and an error is raised when it is not callable. Arguments are evaluated with `args_build` and the parent body runs with `derived = 1`, so the parent's fields are installed on the instance only after `super()`.
